description: Character DNA for all twelve cinematic chess pieces. Every piece carries a stable identity (face/armor/material/weapon IDs plus architecture flags) that the Cinematic Chess Entity Framework resolves at spawn time. Face-bearing assets require Tumbo's approval before any public use.

identityRules.faceApproval: No face-bearing asset ships publicly without Tumbo's explicit approval.
identityRules.malePieces: Male human-headed pieces use Tumbo's approved face reference (FACE_Tumbo_Male_01) through the MetaHuman facial pipeline.
identityRules.queens: Queens carry a separate feminine MetaHuman identity (FACE_Feminine_Regal_01) — never the male face reference.
